name: Green River (Flaming Gorge)
blurb: Dam-release tailwater below Flaming Gorge Dam through Red Canyon (Section A), to Browns Park (B) and on through Browns Park (C). Cold, clear water; PFDs required; no motors.

sections.notes: Section A. USFS: 7 miles, rapids class I and II. BLM: flotation tubes NOT recommended; PFDs required; flows fluctuate with dam releases (800-4500+ cfs).

guideTimes.conditions: Red Canyon Lodge describes about three hours travelling straight through the seven-mile Section A. This is approximate visitor guidance with no stated flow or craft-specific calibration; fishing and other stops can make the trip much longer.
guideTimes.sourceName: Red Canyon Lodge: Flaming Gorge rafting guide

sections.notes: Section C through Browns Park; mostly flat water. Miles from 1990s brochure ramp list (15.4 to 26.2); newer BLM map lists Swallow Canyon camp at mile 27.0. Swallow Canyon ramp is river left.
